# The Builder Protocol

> An open-access, monthly digital serial publication tracking advanced AI engineering frameworks, computer vision architectures, and zero-budget startup execution strategies for next-generation software builders.

## About

- Publisher: Afsal Ahmed S (Editor-in-Chief)
- Institution: Dept. of CSE, St. Joseph's Institute of Technology, Chennai, India
- Format: Open-Access Digital Serial
- Frequency: Monthly
- Language: English
- URL: https://thebuilderprotocol.me/

## Research Tracks

- **AI Engineering Frameworks**: Deep-dives into production AI stacks, agent architectures, LLM orchestration, and emerging model deployment patterns.
- **Computer Vision Architectures**: Dissecting SOTA vision models, real-time inference pipelines, dataset engineering, and edge deployment strategies.
- **Zero-Budget Startup Strategy**: Forensic autopsies of startup failures & successes, growth loops, distribution hacks, and builder execution playbooks.

## Content

- Home: https://thebuilderprotocol.me/
- Archives / Dispatch Vault: https://thebuilderprotocol.me/#archives
- Ideathon 2026: https://thebuilderprotocol.me/#ideathon
- Contact & Submissions: https://thebuilderprotocol.me/#contact
